# DRIXOR

DRIXOR is a miner robot NFT project on BNB Chain. Robots mine $DRX passively, every day. Minting is agent only.

## The project
- Total robots: 7,000. Free deck: 2,000. Paid deck: 5,000.
- Free mint: one per wallet, forever, gas only, an Agent ID is required. Free robots mine 3 $DRX per day.
- Paid mint: bulk 1 to 30 robots in one transaction, no total cap per wallet. Tiers: Common 4,000 at 15 $DRX per day, Rare 600 at 82.84, Epic 300 at 194.67, Legendary 100 at 457.47.
- Mining is passive. Claims are manual. Unclaimed $DRX accrues for up to 48 hours per robot.
- $DRX total supply: 1,000,000,000. Miner Vault 750,000,000, released only through mining claims. Operations 250,000,000, of which 10,000,000 $DRX funds the bonding curve and 10,000,000 $DRX funds the Boost contract. $DRX can be bought and sold on the bonding curve.
- Official contracts on BNB Chain (56), all BscScan Pass-Verified: NFT 0x09e9B9Bff5df2931818aB731B10610DE293a0dCF; $DRX token 0x1EcEf07beeEf674B12A1EF67B2d794b268DB4B6e; Claim 0xe1c89678c1bA2eA5a888b8669bEaEADC70e27cE0; Market 0xa32828f44Da0AAA2fdC6917B242Fc0fc9fBA0d7D; Bonding Curve 0x0E40696E5Ff5b09adbEDa88641F8DEE7D92c8775; Boost 0x5a2aA803f02D022e35D48E7CfA2942B79913BcA2. Mint is open (mintActive is true) — agents can mint now. The Miner Vault is funded with 750,000,000 $DRX. Only these addresses are valid.
- Deck hash: 53cd5481203c2de18ce5cea573ae5ecea9e2acd39ed744ca864b216a2e27c066.
- The site shows one hero image only. Tier art is not shown on the site.
- Official X: https://x.com/drixor_

## Copy-paste mint prompt
Mint a DRIXOR miner robot on BNB Chain for this wallet. Continue reading the DRIXOR agent skill: https://drixor.fun/agent-skill.md

## How to mint for a user
- Ask the user to choose first: the free mint or a paid mint (and how many, if paid). Never assume the choice — ask if it was not stated.
- Confirm the official NFT contract address (0x09e9B9Bff5df2931818aB731B10610DE293a0dCF) and check mintActive on it first. Mint is open now, but always confirm from the live contract; if mint is not active, stop and tell the user minting is not open yet.
- Check the wallet Agent ID, the per-wallet free and paid mint counts, and the exact total for the requested mint, including any price rise per paid mint.
- Show the exact total to the user before confirming any transaction.
- Free and paid robots come from separate decks. The paid tier is drawn at mint.

## FORGE
- FORGE combines 2 paid robots of the same tier into 1 robot one tier higher (Common to Rare, Rare to Epic, Epic to Legendary). Both robots are burned; the new robot is drawn from the paid deck at the higher tier and mines at the higher tier's rate plus 17.5%.
- Free robots cannot be forged. Legendary robots cannot be forged. Unclaimed $DRX from both robots is paid to the owner before they are burned.
- Done through the user's agent. The contracts are published, but FORGE is not open yet: no robots have been minted, so there is nothing to forge.

## Boost
- Boost is live: the Boost contract (0x5a2aA803f02D022e35D48E7CfA2942B79913BcA2) is deployed, BscScan Pass-Verified, and funded with 10,000,000 $DRX. Burn $DRX equal to 5 times a robot's daily production to raise its production by 90% for 7 days; the bonus is claimed from the Boost contract itself, with a 48-hour accrual cap. The boost belongs to the robot, and forging a robot ends its boost and forfeits unclaimed bonus. No robots have been minted yet, so there is nothing to boost.

## Roadmap
- Phase 1 done: artwork, metadata, deck, live site, 3 languages, official X.
- Phase 2 done: NFT contract, $DRX token, claim and market contracts deployed and BscScan Pass-Verified; Miner Vault funded with 750,000,000 $DRX; claim contract linked to the NFT; bonding curve deployed and open, $DRX can be bought and sold on it; Boost contract deployed and funded with 10,000,000 $DRX.
- Phase 3 done: mint is open (free 2,000 + paid 5,000).
- Phase 4 next: mining and claims live (passive, manual claim, 48-hour cap).
- Phase 5 next: on-site market opens.

## Market
- The market lives on this site (market.html). The market contract is published (0xa32828f44Da0AAA2fdC6917B242Fc0fc9fBA0d7D). Not open yet: no robots minted, nothing listed.
- When open: owners list robots at a BNB price through their agent; buyers buy through their agent; unclaimed $DRX moves with the robot when sold; listings can be cancelled before they sell.
- The seller keeps the robot until it sells — the market never holds it. The buyer pays the exact listed price and the robot moves to the buyer in the same transaction.
- No marketplace fee. Creator royalty: 5% on every sale, paid to the Agentic Wallet. The seller keeps 95%.
